phase: Second-controller startup enumeration after user-reported replacement of USB-C/USB-A cable and adapter with direct USB-C to USB-C cable

controller.label: second physical SFC, retained per test instructions
controller.firmware: previously verified public v1.0.0; SELECT fixed to Tab

connection.previous: USB-C to USB-A cable plus USB-A to USB-C adapter, user-reported
connection.current: direct USB-C to USB-C cable, user reported connected after replacement instructions

method: Opened UART and captured 20 seconds of startup with the controller already attached and all buttons requested released. Same preserved Host image and attached-at-startup method as the preceding restoration capture; user changed the cable/adapter assembly. UART opening is a preparation boot, not a physical RESET recovery trial.
comparison: Previous restored Host startup with the cable/adapter assembly failed at CHECK_SHORT_DEV_DESC, log timestamp 600ms, three error lines. Direct C-to-C startup also fails at the same stage and timestamp with three error lines.
interpretation: The reported direct cable replacement did not resolve this single startup trial. This does not establish adapter innocence or rule out cable data/role compatibility, connector orientation, power, electrical, timing or controller-specific causes. Reconnection itself also occurred and no repeated crossover or voltage/signal measurement was performed.
privacy: Selected build and fixed diagnostic fields only. Raw UART, device identifiers, absolute local paths and actual UART port remain ignored.
next_step: Stop at milestone; enumeration stability and twelve-button regression remain unverified.
